set.pl: Nielson farm, W half of sec 14 T141N R47W, Morken Twp (Clay Co.)
set.t: Sod-shanty site (stood 32 yrs) likely near the SW corner of the section; the later house (no cellar) in the SE¼ SW¼. NW¼ was probably the tree claim. Private farmland: permission needed.
pinev: Pin midway between the 1909 plat building dot and the 1939 aerial farmstead, both on the W half of sec 14; r 300 m
Section named in the 1916 Moorhead Daily News

src: 1909 Ogle Clay Co. atlas, Morken plate (UMedia coll231:10304, ptr 10248)
